end.summary:
Practised reading position–time graphs as motion stories, not paths.
Identified slope of an x–t graph as velocity and calculated 20 m ÷ 10 s = 2 m/s and 30 m ÷ 10 s = 3 m/s.
Explained that steeper lines show greater velocity, horizontal lines show zero velocity, and negative slope shows opposite direction.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised interpreting position–time graphs through slope, direction, and motion examples. Ira used the method of comparing distance travelled in the same time and correctly described steeper, horizontal, and negative-slope lines; a brief uncertainty was followed later by correct explanations. At home, ask Ira to describe three graph lines aloud: steep positive, horizontal, and negative, including the motion story for each.
